component.name: Bars
component.summary: Private, on-device voice dictation for every app

description.p: Hold a shortcut, speak, and let go: Bars transcribes your voice with a fast local speech model and types the text into whatever app you are using. Nothing is sent over the network.

ul.li: Push-to-talk or hands-free dictation from a global shortcut
NVIDIA Parakeet and Canary models running on your CPU via ONNX Runtime
Removes filler words, supports a personal dictionary and snippets
Lives in the system tray with a minimal recording indicator
Model downloads trust the system's certificates, so they work behind company proxies and antivirus that inspect HTTPS.
macOS: changing the shortcut works again; the shortcut keeps working after macOS asks for a password, and with Caps Lock on.
The version is shown in the settings sidebar and by bars --version.
macOS: switching microphones no longer freezes Bars, and Bars no longer changes the microphone's format for other apps.
The setup assistant's microphone check lets you pick another microphone.
macOS: no longer crashes when inserting text after dictation.
macOS: setup asks only for Accessibility, and Allow access opens its settings.
macOS: the disk image shows its background and layout again.
Arm64 builds for Linux and Windows are paused.

description.p: Windows and macOS: global shortcut, typing and pasting, tray, setup assistant, launch at login, and the dictation pill.

ul.li: macOS: Fn (Globe) works as a shortcut; menu-bar app without a Dock icon.
Arm64 builds for Linux and Windows.
The setup assistant notices permissions granted in system settings.
